Crime & Law · India

Centre directs Telegram to block pirated content, seeks report

The Indian government has issued a notice to Telegram, demanding the platform block and remove pirated films and OTT content. The directive requires Telegram to take immediate action and submit a report within 15 days. This action comes amidst ongoing discussions about user privacy on social media platforms.
